name: Mike Tooman
occupation: Former Weston County clerk (appointed June 2026; resigned effective July 28, 2026). WyoFile reported that at a June 4, 2026, appointment hearing he described his work as an election judge for 17 years and as a senior systems architect.
prior_offices: Election judge (17 years, as he stated at the June 4, 2026, hearing reported by WyoFile); Weston County clerk (appointed June 8, 2026, by District Court Judge Matthew F.G. Castano; resigned effective July 28, 2026)
background: James Michael Tooman, also listed as Mike Tooman, served as Weston County clerk in 2026. WyoFile, republishing the News Letter Journal, reported on June 8, 2026, that after county commissioners failed to fill a vacancy, District Court Judge Matthew F.G. Castano appointed him on June 8 to serve until a successor was elected and took office, and that at a June 4 hearing Tooman said he had been an election judge for 17 years and worked as a senior systems architect. Official July 29, 2026, commissioners minutes record that Chairman Nathan Todd read Tooman's resignation letter effective July 28, 2026, at noon, and that the board accepted the resignation and appointed Deputy Clerk Amber Green as acting county clerk. The News Letter Journal later reported that Tooman had withdrawn from the August 2026 Republican primary for clerk but still received 280 votes.
